objective: Discover and fingerprint the Darwinex MT5 environment read-only, then materialize an isolated clone without launching MT5 or Candidate3.
auto_selection_policy: Only auto-select if exactly one installation has a deterministic Darwinex marker in installation/origin metadata; otherwise stop with AMBIGUOUS_MT5_TARGET and modify nothing.
active_environment_policy: The active Darwinex installation and data directory are read-only inputs. Clone output must be outside Program Files and outside the active data directory.
reparse_policy: Reject symbolic links, junctions, and reparse points that escape approved roots during clone materialization.
secret_policy: Allowlist-only export. Do not read account credential stores, certificates, saved passwords, community credentials, or unrelated terminal databases.
promotion_gate: MVP2A_PASS requires exact source->clone hash parity for the allowlisted installation bytes plus independent manifest reconstruction. It does not authorize MT5 launch.
